Name: Shammah the Harodite
Summary: Shammah the Harodite was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Shammah son of Agee the Hararite and from Shammah son of Jesse.
KeyStory: Shammah the Harodite stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: Three Shammahs served David — the record keeps each one's place.
